doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

title: Opening: introductions at the Barnes home on Louisa Street
summary: Bill Russell opens the session at the home of Emile (Mealy) and Paul Barnes and gets Emile's name.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: So we're all ready to start. I'll give my voice. This is Bill Russell and we're down at the home of Mealy Barnes and Paul Barnes on Louisa Street. Do you want to give your name Mr. Mealy Barnes, Emile Barnes? Mm-hmm. What is your full name? My full name is Emile Barnes. Any middle name or initial? Mealy Barnes. Oh. That's Mealy.
